component.name: Grok Monitor
component.summary: Shared Grok usage, once per account, in the COSMIC panel

description.p: A panel applet for the COSMIC™ desktop that shows the shared weekly Grok usage pool once per account. Grok Build and Grok Bot draw from that pool.
This unofficial applet reads the Grok CLI session on disk (read-only) and calls the Grok CLI billing endpoint. It is not affiliated with xAI.
Read an additional Grok CLI home so a personal grok login can supply weekly usage without replacing the default ~/.grok session.
Apply a saved work or personal link after legacy profile captions establish that role. A chip with no Grok CLI login stays blank instead of claiming the account is signed out.
Join a Grok CLI sign-in to the work or personal account only when that mapping is saved. Panel captions are Grok (sim sys) and Grok (pers). An unmapped sign-in stays on its own chip.
Show the shared weekly pool once per account. The work account is labeled sim sys and the personal account is labeled pers. Remove the retired Grok Bot Monitor applet from the panel.
Version bump to match the shared applet package.
Report when weekly credits will run out in the Build popup.
Show weekly usage pace (on track / ahead / behind) in the Build popup.
Replace personal machine examples in docs and tests with generic placeholders.
Grok Bot Monitor reads accounts from every Grok Bot* config directory.
